summary: FastPartner AB (publ), a real estate company, owns, develops, and manages properties in Sweden. The company offers its properties to technology, service, and industrial companies, as well as entrepreneurs and community services, such as retirement homes, schools, state and municipal administrations, and healthcare facilities. It is also involved in leasing properties. The company was incorporated in 1984 and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. FastPartner AB (publ) operates as a subsidiary of Compactor Fastigheter AB.
